messages:
Mia (Finance): FYI Lumenix is past due on invoice `INV-2026-048` for $48,200 — 45 days overdue. Sent a final notice this morning.
BillingBot: Automated invoice link: https://billing.redwood.ai/inv/INV-2026-048 — status: PAST_DUE.
Omar (AM): Got it. Any reply from Rajesh/finance team over there?
Mia (Finance): Only an ack. They said cashflow is tight and asked if we can do an extension or payment plan.
Rebecca (Collections): Suggest we offer either: 1) 3 monthly ACH installments (no discount) or 2) one-time settlement at a discount. Recommend we keep the settlement <= 15%. Also propose adding a late fee waiver if they commit today.
Jordan (Legal): Fine with a short amendment for payment schedule. No change to core T&Cs. Need signature and explicit ACH mandate.
Mia (Finance): Heads-up — I need manager approval for any discount >8%. If we do installment, require auto-ACH and an amendment that specifies payment dates + recovery clause.
Sarah (Finance Manager): I can approve up to 15% one-time settlement if it closes this week and they provide ACH mandate + signed amendment.
Omar (AM): I'll ping Rajesh now with two options and request which they prefer.
Omar (AM) -> Rajesh (DM): Rajesh — we can do (A) 12% one-time settlement if paid by 2026-04-10, or (B) 3 equal ACH installments on 2026-04-15, 2026-05-15, 2026-06-15 (no discount). Need signed amendment + ACH mandate. Which works?
Rajesh (Lumenix): Thanks Omar — option B looks safer for us. We'll sign amendment and set up ACH. First payment should clear today, can you send the ACH mandate link?
Mia (Finance): Sending ACH collection link now: `https://payments.redwood.ai/ach/mandate?cid=Lumenix&inv=INV-2026-048`
Rebecca (Collections): Noted. I'll draft amendment and email for signature, add auto-collect on the dates.
Rebecca (Collections): Quick internal — once ACH mandate received, please flag in ledger and set reminders 3 days prior to each debit.
Mia (Finance): I'll update the AR ledger and mark as 'payment plan — active' once we get the mandate + first txn.
Jordan (Legal): I'll attach the standard payment amendment to Rebecca's draft. No special clauses required.
Omar (AM): Thanks team. Rajesh — please reply here when the mandate is signed and the first payment posts. Appreciate it. :thumbsup:
Rajesh (Lumenix): Mandate signed (sent), first payment initiated — should post in 24 hours. Thanks for the flexibility.
Rebecca (Collections): Received mandate copy. Scheduling first collect for tomorrow, and created follow-up tasks. :white_check_mark:
Mia (Finance): Closing loop — once first payment settles, we'll remove final notice and clear the dunning tag. Logging this as: 3-installment plan, ACH, amendment signed.
Omar (AM): Great. If anything goes sideways, escalate to me and Jordan.
Rebecca (Collections): Will do. Closing thread after first settlement posts. :money_with_wings:
